output.summary: An annual trailing herb with an uncertain native origin, muskmelon has many cultivated varieties. Its fruit may have sweet or bland flesh and smooth, ribbed, wrinkled or netted rind; depending on the variety, it is eaten fresh, dried or cooked, while some are grown for edible seeds.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten fresh, dried or cooked; some varieties are cultivated for edible seeds, which may be processed into oil.
